scope: Week 4 personal record persistence, interrupted game save and restore, no re-scoring after relaunch

flutter_tests.skipped_reason: Live OCI check runs only with --dart-define=VERIFY_OCI_REMOTE=true; not re-run this week

added: checkpoint restores a game mid-way and finishes identically
checkpoint restores new and finished games
checkpoint rejects other versions and tampered state

manual_web_check: Built web app in the browser: created a game, played to the 2nd inning, reloaded, resumed the identical state, finished the game, reloaded again; the record stayed (1 game) and no interrupted game remained

storage.android_and_desktop: JSON files in the app support directory (kbo_save/records.json, kbo_save/saved_game.json); written to <name>.json.tmp then renamed over the original; writes are serialized

saved_game_format.checkpoint: kbo_game_checkpoint v1 with engine_version, data_version, random_algorithm, seed, starting pitchers, substitutions, plate appearance count, random state and current state

verified_behaviors: Records survive relaunch: points, prediction count, decided count, hits, current and best streak, recent games
A game ID already scored is never scored again after relaunch
Corrupted record file is kept as records.corrupt and the app starts with empty records and a notice
Unsupported record schema and malformed entries are rejected
Games finished before stored records are loaded are merged instead of overwriting the file
A failed record save shows a notice and keeps the record in memory
File store replaces through a temporary file, serializes concurrent writes and leaves no temporary file
Interrupted game is saved at start, after every plate appearance and every substitution
Engine checkpoint replays seed and substitutions to the same state, random state, lineup, pitchers and final result
Checkpoint from another engine version, data version, seed, random state or tampered score is rejected
Home shows the interrupted game with score, half inning and prediction; resume continues it
Leaving the game screen saves progress without a confirmation dialog
A game saved as finished but not yet scored is scored once on resume; a second resume of the same file does not add points
The interrupted game file is deleted only after the record save completes
Starting a new game while an interrupted game exists asks before discarding it
An interrupted game from another data version shows discard only
Existing week 3 flow test (team selection, prediction, substitutions, result, single scoring) still passes
limitations: Android device storage and app kill during a write were not tested on hardware; file replacement was tested on the Windows host file system
Restoring replays all plate appearances, which is fast for one game (under 10,000 plate appearances by engine guard)
No separate settings screen exists yet, so there are no user preferences to persist
